overview: Eastern Wu controlled the Yangzi delta and southern coast under the Sun family. Its naval power and maritime trade connected China to Southeast Asia, while southern China developed economically and culturally.

items.text: Advanced shipbuilding with multi-masted junks and stern rudders.
Maritime trade with Southeast Asia, India and possibly the Roman world.
Exotic goods imported from the south: pearls, ivory, rhinoceros horn.
Economic development of the Yangzi delta laid foundations for later southern prosperity.

fall.text: The Jin dynasty launched a massive invasion with naval forces sailing down the Yangzi, forcing Wu to surrender and reunifying China.
